Author: Marco Lovato
Description: Automatically switches StreamDeck profiles when Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, or Windows Terminal (WindowsApps/MSIX packages) become the active window — fixing the Smart Profile detection gap for these apps.
Name: WindowsApps Profile Switcher

Actions.Name: WindowsApps Switcher
Actions.Tooltip: Monitors active window and switches profiles for WindowsApps (Teams, WhatsApp, Terminal)
